description: Add social features: leaderboard (top performers by accuracy/streak/questions), study groups (create/join, share question sets, group progress), and activity feed (recent achievements)
steps: Create src/features/social/ directory: types/, utils/, components/
Create src/features/social/types/index.ts with types: LeaderboardEntry, StudyGroup, GroupMember, GroupProgress, ActivityFeedItem, Achievement

Create src/features/social/utils/storage.ts for localStorage persistence of: user's groups, activity feed items, leaderboard cache (keys: 'cfa-buddy-groups', 'cfa-buddy-activity-feed', 'cfa-buddy-leaderboard')

Create src/features/social/utils/leaderboard.ts: calculateLeaderboard() computes rankings from localStorage data - sorts by accuracy, streak days, questions completed. Returns top 20 entries. Uses local profile for current user entry

Create src/features/social/utils/achievements.ts: detectNewAchievements() checks gamification state (src/features/gamification/) and generates achievement events (first 100 questions, 7-day streak, subject mastery, etc.)

Create src/features/social/components/leaderboard.tsx - shows ranked list with: rank number, avatar placeholder, display name, accuracy %, streak days, questions count. Current user highlighted. Tabs for: accuracy, streak, questions
Create src/features/social/components/study-groups.tsx - group management: create group (name, description), join group (invite code), list user's groups with member count and recent activity
Create src/features/social/components/group-detail.tsx - shows group members, shared question sets, group progress comparison chart

Create src/features/social/components/activity-feed.tsx - shows recent achievements across the community: 'User reached 500 questions', 'User achieved 7-day streak', 'User mastered Fixed Income'. Limited to last 20 items
Add route: src/app/(protected)/social/page.tsx with tabs for Leaderboard, Groups, Activity
Add 'Community' link to sidebar navigation in src/shared/components/layout/sidebar.tsx
Add unit tests in src/features/social/__tests__/leaderboard.test.ts and achievements.test.ts
Run full verification: npm run lint, npx tsc --noEmit, npm run build, npm run test
acceptance_criteria: /social page shows Leaderboard, Groups, and Activity tabs
Leaderboard ranks users by accuracy, streak, and questions completed
Users can create study groups with name and description
Users can join groups via invite code
Group detail shows members and progress
All tests pass, lint clean, build succeeds
verification: eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run lint
eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run build
eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run test
